presentation.title: AI Engineer | Full-Stack Developer
presentation.description: I transform business challenges into intelligent and scalable digital products. I specialize in integrating advanced Artificial Intelligence models with Full-Stack development, ensuring efficiency, innovation, and solid technical performance.

about_me.title: About Me
about_me.description: I am an AI Engineer and Full-Stack Developer focused on integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) and autonomous agents into real-world applications. Rather than just interacting with AI, I build the logic and technical architecture around it (RAG, MCP, n8n). Supported by a solid foundation in modern Full-Stack development (React, Python, Java) and Cloud services, I bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI tools and enterprise software.

additionalInfo.1: Versatile software developer with professional experience building Full-Stack applications, Cloud infrastructures, and integrating Artificial Intelligence solutions.
additionalInfo.2: I stand out for my technical adaptability and creative problem-solving, always focusing on innovation and delivering real business value.
additionalInfo.3: Graduated as a Systems Technologist (Universidad ECCI), Diploma in Software Development (Universidad del Bosque/MinTic), and currently a Software Engineering student.

jobs.description: As part of the development team, my role has expanded beyond the Frontend to encompass the integration of intelligent systems into the company's core applications. I am responsible for building autonomous agents, RAG pipelines, and automating corporate workflows, ensuring these AI-driven solutions are securely integrated and directly optimize business operations.

Specialized in frontend and backend web solutions, including projects like Essence Atelier, Care&Life, Firseco, and a generic store. Used React, JavaScript, Spring Boot, and Python, managing SQL and NoSQL databases.
Worked in the Networks and Telecommunications area as a customer service specialist, providing support and making sales. This experience strengthened my communication and problem-solving skills.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: I have worked on projects using Java, JavaScript, Spring Boot, HTML, CSS, Angular, React, and Python, among other technologies. My focus spans from web application development to backend logic, integrating both relational and non-relational databases to ensure quality and efficiency. Additionally, I have implemented solutions involving artificial intelligence and automated agents, applying these technologies to optimize processes, enhance user experience, and add strategic value to projects.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Do you have a project in mind or are you looking to strengthen your tech team? I'm always open to new professional challenges and strategic collaborations. Write to me and let's talk about how I can bring value to your ideas.
